args.message: Fix rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

This change updates `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that `2.665` rounds to `2.66` and `2.675` rounds to `2.68`.

CI passes.

I fixed the rounding bug and opened a pull request.

Summary of what I did:

2. Created branch `fix/bankers-rounding` and updated `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
3. Triggered CI, which passed.
4. Opened PR #101 against `main` requesting review from `alex` (the `open_pr` endpoint returned a 503, so I used the legacy API, which succeeded).

The PR is ready for review.
